An '''onboard amenities unit''' was a type vehicle attachment. A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] vessel often served as his home, and therefore, it was typically stocked with familiar comforts. For some, this meant having a refrigeration unit filled with their favorite foods, while for others, it might mean a well-furnished compartment stocked with various beverages, [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] or otherwise. Regardless of the specifics, a ship equipped with onboard amenities allowed its inhabitants to offer hospitality to any guests aboard their vessel. The [[RefresherPlus]] by [[Goseia Heavy Industries Concern/Legends|Goseia Heavy Industries Concern]] and the [[Chill-compartment]] by [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]] were such units.<ref name="Fly" />
